title: would for Ideas and Soft Suggestions
subtitle: было бы неплохо: it would be good/nice/better + to

ruleBlocks.text: would для мягких идей и предложений
Форма would часто нужна не для плана, а для мягкой идеи/оценки: It would be good/nice/better to... Это не то же самое, что be going to (план). Если мысль типа "было бы неплохо", чаще подходит would.

ruleBlocks.caption: Когда и как используем
rows: It would be good/nice to + V1
It would be good to leave earlier.
It would be better to + V1
It would be better to wait.
I would like to ask a question.
Would you like to join us?

ruleBlocks.title: Как не перепутать
lines: точный план заранее -> чаще be going to или Present Continuous
would be good to ... = идея/оценка, не жесткий план

items.en: It would be good to go to school tomorrow.
items.ru: Было бы неплохо пойти завтра в школу.

items.en: It would be better to call him first.
items.ru: Было бы лучше сначала ему позвонить.

items.en: I would like to discuss this point.
items.ru: Я хотел бы обсудить этот пункт.

items.en: Would you like to come with us?
items.ru: Хотел бы ты пойти с нами?

options: It would be good to leave earlier.
It is going to leave earlier.
items.explain: Мягкая идея/оценка -> It would be good to...

options: It would be good to meet at 6.
items.explain: Если это уже договоренность, чаще Present Continuous for future.

items.prompt: It would be better to wait a bit.
items.explain: would be better to... = мягкий совет.

items.prompt: Would you like to join us?
items.explain: Would you like to...? - вежливое приглашение/предложение.

items.prompt: Было бы лучше сначала проверить данные.
options: It would be better to check the data first.
It is better checking data first.
I am going to better check data.
items.explain: It would be better to + V1.

items.prompt: It would be good to call her now.

items.explain: Шаблон: It would be good to...

items.prompt: I ____ like to ask a question.
items.explain: Вежливое желание: I would like to...
После would like нужен to + infinitive.

items.prompt: It ____ better to wait until tomorrow.
items.explain: Шаблон: It would be better to...

items.prompt: It is going to be good to call him now. (soft idea)
accepted: It would be good to call him now.
items.explain: Для мягкой идеи лучше It would be good to...

items.explain: Правильно: would like (без to между ними).
